gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-kadwa: Kadwa is a serif with open-ended curves and a x-height taller than you'd expect, set under Baloo Tammudu 2's tall, rounded display forms. They fill the space together.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text carries a literary, dignified voice, its curved letters taking a wide entrance and its lowercase filling most of the height. And Baloo Tammudu 2 above it, rounded and tall, gives that quiet text a confident front door.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-piazzolla: Authoritative and refined, Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with an e opened like a pried clasp. Baloo Tammudu 2 brings the swagger; Piazzolla does the talking.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-pridi: Pridi stands its small letters up proud, almost capital-sized, with generous gaps between curve ends and stems, under Baloo Tammudu 2's tall rounded display. Pridi's refinement is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-scope-one: Scope One lets its counters spill into the surrounding space, with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height, below Baloo Tammudu 2's tall rounded heading. Their shapes echo each other's openness.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum has a c as open as a bent paperclip. Baloo Tammudu 2 stands tall and rounded above it, while the body's high, squared-off x-height gives the page a dignified, editorial weight.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-fauna-one: Soft, deep-bellied and a bit theatrical: Baloo Thambi 2 sits over Fauna One, a serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. The heading performs and the text settles in.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-glegoo: Baloo Thambi 2 swells through the lowercase with a deep midsection and visible gaps, over Glegoo's tall serif letters with big counters and wide, unclosed mouths. Glegoo keeps a long page unhurried and easy to follow.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-graduate: Baloo Thambi 2 is best at making a headline feel playful and expressive, with its deep lowercase midsection. Graduate, a classic serif with generous white between letters and almost no capital-to-lowercase height difference, is best at looking dignified and bookish.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-kadwa: A deep lowercase midsection and distinct gaps in c, e and s give Baloo Thambi 2 its expressive look. And Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height, makes the strongest partner: classic and editorial.
